item.title: Global chokepoint pressure drives Asia to Arctic trade routes
item.description: Asian nations began pilot voyages over a decade ago to find faster routes to Europe and the Middle East that were less vulnerable to chokepoints.

item.title: Sikh truck driver stabbed amid rise in anti-South Asian rhetoric
item.description: The driver said he was shaken by a violent encounter at a rest stop, which he described as unprovoked.

item.title: Reshaping memories may be key to raising self-esteem
item.description: Psychologist Marisa Franco's new book explains why feeling good about yourself matters and offers a memory technique that has been adapted.
